pr_metadata.title: Add option to record step size metrics from AdamW
pr_metadata.description:
- Adds configuration field `optimizer.record_update_metrics`, which
  defaults to `False`, but when set to `True` will trigger AdamW to
  collect the step size norm and absolute max for each parameter.
- Changes the behavior of the Lion optimizer to only record the update cosine
  similarity when `optimizer.record_update_metrics` is `True` in order to be
  consistent with the API.


See https://wandb.ai/ai2-llm/petew-update-logging?nw=nwuserepwalsh for a comparison of a run with and without optimizer update logging.

gold_comments.issue_summary: It may be better to put `_collecting_metrics` in the `Optimizer` class instead. Then the type checker won't complain in `clip_grads_and_collect_metrics` about it not being defined in `__init__`.
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The comment must cite the line `self._collecting_metrics = False` in `AdamW.__init__` (added at line 382) and note that the type checker may complain about it being undefined in `clip_grads_and_collect_metrics` when called on an `Optimizer` reference.
gold_comments.rationale: A human reviewer would raise this to improve type safety and avoid potential mypy/pyright errors when `clip_grads_and_collect_metrics` accesses `_collecting_metrics` on an `Optimizer` instance that might not be an `AdamW`.
